args: case "$GLASSROOT_PYTHON" in "$GLASSROOT_REPO"/*) echo "x-gate: GLASSROOT_PYTHON is inside the repository; not starting" >&2; exit 1;; esac; cd "$GLASSROOT_REPO" && git fetch -q origin main && for f in scripts/distribute.py scripts/x_gate_mcp.py; do [ "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD:"$f")" = "$(git hash-object --no-filters -- "$f")" ] || { echo "x-gate: $f differs from origin/main; not starting" >&2; exit 1; }; done && exec "$GLASSROOT_PYTHON" scripts/x_gate_mcp.py
